description: The `shout` command's own bubble: a colonist calling attention to themselves, spoken over the noise it already publishes. Every line is digit-free and names nobody, per the hardcore contract.
A shambler has just closed a hold (`grab.started`). Never 'I'm bitten' -- a grab is not a bite, and the hardcore contract hides which one a hold becomes until treatment finds it.
Said by whoever pulled a held colonist free (`grab.broken` with cause rescue), not by the one who was held.
Said by the treater, not the patient, when a treatment channel begins (`treatment.begun`).
Said by whoever just joined the colony (`survivor.joined`) -- a recruit taken in, or a body the world spawned.
A waiting recruit or stranger, the first time the controlled body comes into reach of them.
lines: You there. Got room for one more?

description: A shambler's own state machine crossing from Wander/Investigate into Seek or Pursue -- a sound-word, not a word, and never a name (it does not know one).
A screamer's alarm cry, alongside its noise.emitted (zombie.screamed).
A colonist's own worst need band is hunger -- the same reading SimNeeds.hud_clause would rank first, restricted to the seven bands a mutter is allowed to name.

lines: This coat isn't keeping anything out.

description: The grief band -- a fever line would only be allowed here if hud_clause would already say it, and it never does for grief, so this stays a plain 'shaken', nothing that names an illness.
